proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.primary_document: Keep the full original patcher JSON tree, including unknown fields, object keys, nested patchers, dependency and parameter dictionaries.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.object_identity: Use a scoped (patcher-path, original string ID) map to internal numeric IDs; retain original IDs for export.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.object_creation: Recognize maxclass=newobj text only through an explicit supported-name and argument parser. Model UI maxclasses separately. Do not substitute number for int/flonum or voice~ for cycle~.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.geometry: Map patching_rect x/y/width/height to editor geometry; preserve presentation fields independently. The current Ultra profile stores only x/y, so it cannot be a lossless Max document.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.connections: Preserve each original patchline and explicit order metadata. Reject or defer unsupported endpoints; never infer execution order from drawing coordinates.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.unsupported: Retain unresolved objects and unknown JSON in the source document, visibly mark them, and prevent execution until all required semantics are implemented.
proposed_import_boundary_not_implemented.export: A Max document export should merge supported edits into its preserved tree. Do not send a lossless source tree directly through the strict ultra-canvas-v1 runtime protocol.
